annotations.title: Québec contractor check (RBQ + RENA + environmental penalties + SEAO public contracts)

description: Call before hiring, paying or subcontracting a Québec (Canada) contractor. One call checks: active RBQ licence (status, categories, restrictions), RENA listing (banned from public contracts), environmental penalties, public contracts awarded on SEAO (count, total, buyers). Verdict ok / review / blocking with reasons and source dates. Input: name, NEQ or RBQ licence number. Official open data. Free over MCP (10/day shared quota); unlimited via x402 at https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/qc-contractor-check ($0.1).
